news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Romello Height (hand) hopeful to return in Week 4
news.desc: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan said he hopes that Romello Height is back against the Broncos.
news.impact: Height was sidelined this past week after going down with a hand injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Dre Greenlaw (quad) to be monitored this week
news.desc: 49ers LB Dre Greenlaw will be monitored in practice this week.
news.impact: Greenlaw suffered the injury in Sunday's win over the Cardinals. His status is up in the air heading into Week 4 against the Broncos.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Trent Williams (stinger) to be monitored this week
news.desc: 49ers LT Trent Williams will be monitored in practice this week.
news.impact: Williams was carted off the field from Sunday's win over the Cardinals. He appears to have avoided a serious injury, but his status is up in the air for Week 4.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Jake Haener waived by Giants
news.desc: The Giants waived QB Jake Haener.
news.impact: This is the corresponding move to the Giants trading for J.J. McCarthy. Haener is expected to re-sign with the Giants practice squad.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Jack Bech (forearm) to miss some time
news.desc: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak said WR Jack Bech is expected to be out for a "little bit" with a fractured forearm.
news.impact: Kubiak added that the team has yet to make a roster decision. He could be placed on injured reserve.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Zach Ertz elevated from Eagles practice squad Monday
news.desc: The Eagles elevated TE Zach Ertz from their practice squad for Monday's game against the Bears.
news.impact: Ertz returned to the Eagles last week after Dallas Goedert (knee) went down. Ertz should be involved, but he's a wait-and-see for now for fantasy managers.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Mike Evans (rib) considered day-to-day
news.desc: 49ers WR Mike Evans is considered day-to-day with a rib strain.
news.impact: It is a positive update for Evans after he was carted off the field during Sunday's win over the Cardinals. His status remains up in the air for Week 4, but it appears he avoided anything too serious.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Bucky Irving 'not on injury report' after Week 3
news.desc: Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles said Bucky Irving "is not on the team's injury report" after Week 3.
news.impact: Irving spent the majority of the fourth quarter on Sunday on the sideline. It was unclear if it was related to an injury, but it appears it wasn't. He should be back in his lead role in Week 4.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) to miss extended time
news.desc: Saints coach Kellen Moore said Travis Etienne Jr. "will miss time."
news.impact: Etienne does not hold a clear timetable to return. Alvin Kamara should take on a bigger role in the Saints backfield with Kendre Miller also taking on a bigger role behind him.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Jayden Daniels (elbow) to practice this week
news.desc: Commanders coach Dan Quinn said Jayden Daniels will travel with the team to London and practice in "some capacity this week."
news.impact: Daniels was not placed on injured reserve, meaning he is expected to miss less than four weeks. He is unlikely to return this week, but a return in Week 5 or 6 could be in play.
